senses.gloss:
f. (also written इल् in Veda). [इल्-क्विप् वा लस्य डः] 
__1 An offering or oblation, libation offered to the gods. 
__2 Prayer, flow of speech. 
__3 The earth. 
__4 Food. 
__5 The rainy season. 
__6 The third of the five prayājas (इडो यजति). 
__7 People or subjects. (pl.) The object of devotion. 
-Comp. 
-देवता a deity of libation.

€2Ā. (ईट्टे, इडाञ्चके, ऐडिष्ट, ईडितुं, ईडित) 
__1 To praise; अग्निमीडे पुरोहितम् [[Rv. 1. 1. 1]]; शालीनतामव्रजदीड्यमानः [[R. 18. 17]]; नेडिषे यदि काकुत्स्थम् [[Bk. 9. 57]], 18. 15. 
__2 To implore, request, ask for (with two acc.); उपस्थाय मातरमन्नमैट्टे [[Rv. 3. 48. 3.]] -Caus. 
__1 To ask. 
__2 To praise.
